instruction.text: Find the image of spring on the diagram to learn more.

feedback.end: In the UK, we get four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. They each last for about 3 months. Spring is March, April and May.

instruction.text: Select the sky to learn about the weather in the spring.

feedback.correct: Spring is the season of new growth. We get mild weather with some rain, which is very good for growing plants.

instruction.text: Find the blossom on the tree to learn more about plants in the spring.

text: On most trees, new leaves grow in spring, and everywhere becomes greener. Lots of plants will flower, and many trees will also begin to blossom.

instruction.text: What about animals? Find the fox pups in this image to learn more about animals in the spring.

text: Most animals in nature have their babies in the spring. This is because the weather starts to improve, the days get longer and there is more food to go round.

instruction.text: Which of these things do you think you would see in spring? Drag the images to the correct groups.

hint.text: Select an image to hear a description.

feedback.finish: Great work! Farmers plant their crops in the spring, because the spring and the summer have great weather for growing plants.

atoms.a: Spring includes the months March, April and May.
Spring is the time of year when leaves fall off of trees.
Spring is the season of new growth.
